selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop chain set in a warped forest / mushroom environment. The player first mines a warped_stem (a block found in warped forests), then mines a warped_trapdoor (which could be pre-placed in the scene but thematically connects to warped wood). In parallel, the player must find a red_mushroom_block, which is the key ingredient for crafting red_dye. The red_mushroom_block must be found before it can be used to craft red_dye. The warped_stem mining provides early tool familiarity and scene exploration that helps locate the red_mushroom_block. This creates a DAG with branching and convergence: mine warped_stem leads to mine warped_trapdoor (sequential exploration in the warped area), and find red_mushroom_block leads to craft red_dye (resource gathering then crafting). Additionally, mining warped_stem helps orient the player in the scene to then find the red_mushroom_block nearby.

edges.reason: Warped trapdoor is located deeper in the warped structure; mining warped_stem first orients player to the warped area
After exploring the warped stem area, player navigates to the nearby red mushroom block location
Red mushroom block must be obtained first as it is the crafting ingredient for red_dye

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because warped_stem drops itself when mined with any axe (wooden axe provided), and the mined item ends up in the player's inventory. This is the most direct check for a mining task.

Uses inventory_has because warped_trapdoor drops itself when mined (can be mined by hand or axe), and the mined item ends up in the player's inventory. This is the standard check for mine tasks where the drop matches the block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to the red mushroom block cluster (centered at spawn-relative -4, 1, 5) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the target'. The cluster is ~6.5 blocks from spawn so the player must actively move toward it. max_distance=5 ensures they get close enough to clearly observe it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted red_dye ends up in the player's inventory. The player crafts 1 red mushroom → 1 red dye at the crafting table. Red mushrooms are obtained by mining the red_mushroom_block cluster (drops 0-2 red mushrooms per block, 7 blocks available). The player does not start with red_dye so any presence confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A compact warped forest clearing on warped nylium ground. Three warped stem columns (3-5 blocks tall) with warped wart block canopy form the eastern section. Warped trapdoors are placed flat on the ground near the stems. A red mushroom block cluster (mushroom shape, 7 blocks) sits to the west. A crafting table on a warped plank pedestal is positioned behind spawn. Player is given a wooden axe for mining.
task_text: In this warped forest clearing: First mine a warped stem from the teal log columns. Then mine one of the warped trapdoors on the ground nearby. Next, find the red mushroom block cluster to the west. Finally, mine some red mushroom blocks and use the crafting table to craft red dye.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center of 21x21 warped nylium platform. East (~3-7, ~0-4, ~2-5): warped stem columns with wart canopy + trapdoors on ground. West (~-5 to ~-3, ~0-2, ~5-6): red mushroom block cluster with stem. North (~0, ~0-1, ~-3): crafting table on pedestal. Wooden axe provided for mining. All tasks reachable within 7 blocks of spawn.
